text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Sirius 
Symboli, while taking a break at an 
open-air cafe—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Fans
text_block_list.text: Eeeek~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, squeals of excitement erupted 
nearby, and I noticed several women 
looking our way. They appear to be fans of 
Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Fan A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, you're Sirius-sama, right...!!? I 
always come to the track to watch you in 
person!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Fan B
text_block_list.text:
If it wouldn't be too much trouble, could 
I get your autograph...!? I'll make it a 
family heirloom!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Haha, not bad at all. Gimme that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just make sure you cherish it with your 
life, got it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, as punishment, I'll sink my 
teeth right into your throat.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek~~!! That sounds awesome too—but I'll 
definitely take great care of it, okay!?!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli smoothly signed autographs 
while giving out fan service. Her 
practiced demeanor had the fans completely 
captivated.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—when the signing was over, their gazes 
suddenly turned toward us.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, who are you...? I 
feel like I've seen you on TV before..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to react to what just happened, I 
end up flustered and confused.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having choked on my words, an awkward 
silence ensued.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Hah. Well, this guy's pretty much my 
pet.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. I see... No wonder it looked 
familiar.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fans left after that, but— for some 
reason, their attitude seemed somehow 
negative...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Oi, wipe that look off your face.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's because you act like that that people 
walk all over you.
choice_data_list: W-What does it look like to you...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Small animals. Creatures that get eaten 
alive unless they hide in the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural for the weak to be eaten 
alive.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you don't wanna end up among the weak, 
you'd better start by realizing that.
choice_data_list: Ah, I'll try to be careful...!
Yeah, I'll try to be careful...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reminding myself once more that, as Sirius 
Symboli's Trainer, I need to carry myself 
with dignity—
choice_data_list: Even so, you seemed really used to it.
Even so, you seemed really used to it.
Do I really look that unconfident?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reminding myself once more that, as Sirius 
Symboli's Trainer, I need to carry myself 
with dignity—
choice_data_list: Even so, you seemed really used to it.
Even so, you seemed really used to it.
Do I really look that unconfident?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was impressed by Sirius Symboli, 
thinking her fan interactions were truly 
second to none.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha, it's wagging its tail and coming over 
on its own. Pretty cute, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Feed 'em a little, and they'll dutifully 
follow you around. Guess keeping 'em 
company ain't the worst idea."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she spoke in a teasing manner— I 
felt once again how generous and accepting 
she is toward those who look up to her.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
At least, considering you're standing next 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, though— You don't need to worry on 
that front.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"No one will ever stand beside me. —Even 
if it isn't you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nodded in agreement. Just as Sirius 
Symboli said, no one could match her sheer 
presence.
